claims.claim: AMEX Enabled is the certification programme for third-party service providers (terminals, cards, HCE, 3DS, tokenisation, platforms, labs); 1,200+ providers have certified products.

claims.claim: SafeKey (EMV 3-D Secure) certification for ACS/3DS Server providers runs through AMEX Enabled; versions 2.0, 2.2 and 2.3 (2.3 adds Secure Payment Confirmation and headless devices).

claims.claim: Integrated Payments Providers Program serves ISOs, ISVs, VARs, iPOS, ESOs, mPOS/SoftPOS and PSP/processor aggregators with specifications, relationship managers and certification under NDA.

claims.label: Verified

claims.title: Tokenization Services | Products | American Express
claims.label: Verified

Token aggregators register via the Amex Enabled Portal; direct merchants use an 'American Express Token Service Developer Portal'; country availability via tokenapprovals@aexp.com. Resource PDFs dated 2025-09-19 and 2026-01-30.
